questions.subject: FILM_STUDIES
questions.learningObjective: Define and distinguish key film studies concepts
questions.stem: Which statement best defines Blocking rehearsal?

options.text: It is the practice of movements before filming in order to refine spacing and timing.
They are instructions describing where and how performers move and speak within a scene.
options.misconception: Confuses Blocking rehearsal with Stage directions

options.text: It is a group of performers whose interactions form the dramatic whole of a scene.
It is an approach emphasizing an actor's emotional identification with the character.
options.misconception: Confuses Blocking rehearsal with Method acting

questions.explanation: It is the practice of movements before filming in order to refine spacing and timing. This is precisely what Blocking rehearsal means; the alternatives describe Stage directions, Ensemble, Method acting, which are different ideas.
questions.hint: Recall the specific meaning of Blocking rehearsal.
